name: JACOBS SOLUTIONS INC.
moat_justification: People-based services franchise: scale, ENR #1 rankings in 18 categories and a record $28.9B backlog, but no network effect, switching cost or owned IP; ROIC proxy in fundamentals.json was 5.3–7.1% in FY2020–FY2023 and only rose to 10.2%/11.2% in FY2024/FY2025, and gross margin is ~25% on the continuing basis (22.1% TTM as pass-through mix surged) — pricing power is thin through a cycle.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 13 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
one_liner: Sound engineering franchise, moat 4/10, but at $138.67 it prices in the backlog supercycle — weighted IRR 7.3%, IV@15% $51.46; clears 15% only below ~$51.
moat_for: Scale and reputation: ENR #1 in 18 categories including data centers
Record backlog $28.9B, up 27.3% y/y, TTM book-to-bill 1.4x gross / 1.2x adjusted net revenue
Diversified secular end markets: data centers, semiconductors, energy & power, transportation, water
Long-standing government and blue-chip client relationships; PA Consulting advisory
moat_against: Talent walks out the door; contracts competitively re-bid — no structural lock-in
ROIC at/below cost of capital through most of the cycle (5.3–7.1% FY2020–FY2023)
Pass-through procurement inflates revenue with almost no fee margin
Acquisition-built, goodwill-heavy balance sheet; PA Consulting integration/tax drag
